title: Setup & backups
description: Get the bot ready in a few steps: language, channels, staff role, modules. Back up, restore and copy settings here, or start from a ready-made template.
languageText: Which language should the bot speak on this server? (Messages, panels and the / command list too.)
channelsText: Where should the bot write? You can change it anytime in Settings.
staffText: Members of the staff role can handle tickets, duty and moderation tools.
modulesText: Turn on what you need — a disabled module’s commands disappear too.
doneText: The bot picks up the new settings within a few seconds.
backupText: Download the server settings as a JSON file and restore them anytime.
badFile: This is not a valid JSON file.
copyText: The same settings on another server of yours — without channels and roles (those differ per server).
noOtherGuilds: No other server where you are a manager and the bot is present.
copyConfirmText: The same settings on the target server will be overwritten.
templatesText: Start with a module selection tailored to a server type.
templateConfirmText: Modules are switched on and off according to the template; other settings stay.

community.title: Community server
community.text: Levels, fun, quests, tickets, music, AI

gaming.title: Gaming server
gaming.text: Full economy, underworld, casino, stocks, clans, fishing

minimal.title: Minimal
minimal.text: Only the ticket system — everything else off

support.title: Support
support.text: Tickets and community support without gaming modules.

server.notBackup: This is not an OrangenBot settings backup.
server.stale: Settings changed. Generate a new preview.

previewText: These settings will change. Check channels and roles before saving.
